description: The AGENT-FOUNDATION-1 inventory carried forward verbatim, plus the AFD-5D2A Atlas contract closure suite. The RC entries are present so a regression caused by the new status/sufficiency/supportTier/comparison contract fails THIS sweep rather than being discovered later.

Same Cloudflare Siteverify round trip as above: the /go -> /register binding cannot complete without a verified CAPTCHA, because `register` is in ALWAYS_ENFORCED. Covered without egress by test:regression:affiliate-attribution and by the PRODUCT-RC-1 cross-service journey, which asserts the closed refusal and then drives the binding through the accepted service functions.

Requires Cloudflare Turnstile test credentials (AFD3B2_TURNSTILE_TEST_SECRET / _SITE_KEY) AND a live HTTPS round trip to https://challenges.cloudflare.com/turnstile/v0/siteverify, whose URL is a hard-coded constant in src/lib/captcha/siteverify.ts. PRODUCT-RC-1 forbids creating external egress. It skips cleanly with a printed reason rather than asserting nothing silently. Its non-HTTP half is fully covered by test:regression:affiliate-attribution (99 assertions, isolated, no server).

Requires AFD3A3_TURNSTILE_TEST_SECRET, _SECRET_SPENT and _SITE_KEY plus a live Cloudflare Siteverify round trip. Forbidden by the PRODUCT-RC-1 no-egress rule. The login CAPTCHA contract itself is covered without egress by test:regression:captcha-turnstile (59 assertions) and test:regression:login-turnstile.

Requires AFD4_TURNSTILE_TEST_SECRET and the same Cloudflare round trip. Forbidden by the PRODUCT-RC-1 no-egress rule. First-deposit ingestion, idempotency, conflict handling and the absence of any balance write are covered without egress by test:regression:pocket-first-deposit (isolated) and by cross-service journey steps 17-20.

forbidden.reason: Reads the live POSTBACK_SECRET, sends a real callback to the live DEV backend and creates a live account. PRODUCT-RC-1 substitutes isolated coverage that uses a copied database, an isolated loopback backend, a synthetic secret and synthetic callbacks, and contacts nothing external: test:regression:pocket-l1-owner (enrolment owner, L1 completion, L2 unlock, zero XP, no balance, idempotent replay, conflicting identity refused, missing/invalid secret refused), test:regression:pocket-direct-postback and test:regression:pocket-direct-postback-e2e (callback accepted, identity bound exactly once, unknown clickid refused, duplicate/conflicting playerid refused), test:regression:pocket-affiliate-url and test:regression:public-referral-url (the referral link is the external affiliate URL built from a public origin), and the PRODUCT-RC-1 cross-service journey (the Academy-visible L1-complete/L2-available state). The only case with NO isolated equivalent is its final assertion that the LIVE primary learner is still at Level 1 — that is a statement about live data, not about this source, and PRODUCT-RC-1 verifies it directly in the closing gates instead.
